opening.argument: The video directly links Forsage registration with buying Ethereum through Trust Wallet, with the title identifying “Trust Wallet How to Buy Ethereum” and the description instructing viewers to “Register and Join Forsage here.” The payment flow is concrete: the speaker says to erase $250 and enter $50 as the minimum, then demonstrates email verification and a card-funded checkout. Adding funds is presented as a path to eventually accessing “those platforms and programs,” while a driver's-license upload may also be required. The records show an instructional promotional route for purchasing tokens to enter Forsage-related programs. Although the speaker says the purchase is not completed in the tutorial, the evidence still does not establish completed payment, delivered access, losses, or the nature of Forsage's services.
